Tom's Red Bicycle: 汤姆攒零花钱买自行车的故事。
Tom wants a new bicycle. His old one is small and slow. Every Saturday, he washes his father's car and gets five dollars.
Tom does not buy candy or toys. He puts all his money in a blue box under his bed. After four months, the box is full.
Today, Tom rides his new red bicycle to school. He is very happy because he buys it with his own money.
